title: Add name-search filter and price sort to FastAPI items API
description: A minimal FastAPI items API needs a name search filter and a price sort query parameter added to the list endpoint.

injections.content:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

_items = [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Widget A", "price": 9.99},
    {"id": 2, "name": "Gadget B", "price": 24.99},
    {"id": 3, "name": "Tool C", "price": 14.99},
    {"id": 4, "name": "Widget Pro", "price": 49.99},
]


@app.get("/items")
def list_items() -> list:
    return _items

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from src.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_list_all():
    r = client.get("/items")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()) == 4

task_spec.prompt:
The FastAPI app in src/app.py has GET /items returning all 4 items. Add two query params:

1. ?q=<query> — case-insensitive substring search on item name. Absent means return all.
2. ?sort=price_asc or ?sort=price_desc — sort results by price. Absent means original order.

Both params compose: ?q=widget&sort=price_desc filters then sorts.

Add 4 tests in tests/test_items.py:
  test_search_widget — ?q=widget returns 2 items (Widget A and Widget Pro)
  test_search_no_match — ?q=xyz returns empty list
  test_sort_asc — ?sort=price_asc returns items with increasing price
  test_sort_desc_with_filter — ?q=widget&sort=price_desc returns Widgets sorted descending

The original test must still pass. Run uv run pytest tests/ -q to confirm.
required_artifacts: 4 new tests covering search and sort
